issue_title: [Feature] 添加日志记录支持，用于调试和监控存储操作

implementation_summary.description: Add logging support to TodoStorage for debugging and monitoring storage operations. Logs are only emitted when FLYWHEEL_DEBUG=1 environment variable is set.

changes.description: Added logging support with DEBUG level logs for load/save operations including file path, todo count, and elapsed time. Added ERROR level logs for exceptions.
New test file with 7 tests covering debug logging for load/save, error logging on exceptions, and verification that logging is disabled by default.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When FLYWHEEL_DEBUG=1, load/save operations output DEBUG logs
Logs include file path, operation result, and elapsed time
Does not affect normal usage performance and output
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_no_logging_when_flywheel_debug_not_set - no logs emitted when FLYWHEEL_DEBUG is not set

risks_and_limitations: Logging is controlled by environment variable FLYWHEEL_DEBUG which must be set before import for consistent behavior
Time measurement uses time.perf_counter() which has minimal overhead but adds a few function calls even when logging is disabled
